hhs_exact_formalization.title: Bidirectional IEEE-754 Palindromic Pivot and 72-Block Concatenation

lemmas.title: Finite IEEE Dyadic Decimal Termination
lemmas.statement: Every finite admitted IEEE binary16/32/64 value decodes exactly to n/2^k and therefore to n*5^k/10^k.

lemmas.title: Independent Pivot Recovery
lemmas.statement: Direction A and direction B independently reconstruct the same canonical frame F and therefore the same source IEEE state.

lemmas.title: 72-Block Concatenation
lemmas.statement: Concat(Block72(F))=F for arbitrary admitted F; reverse-side block traversal independently reconstructs F.

lemmas.title: Nonfinite Bit Identity
lemmas.statement: Infinity and NaN encodings retain exact sign/payload bit identity but no numeric-value authority.
